latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ChromaDB Memory with Ollama embeddings.

- Integrates ChromaDB vector database for long-term memory storage.
- Supports embeddings via Ollama with configurable model.
- Automatically recalls and injects relevant context before each turn.
- Allows configuration of collection names and result filtering (minScore, autoRecall count).
- All settings customizable via config options.
